concerns.text: "FR-005: System MUST perform a semantic equivalence check (e.g., visual similarity score ≥ 0.95 or expert rating) ..." lacks a concrete definition of the similarity algorithm, model, or rating procedure, and provides no justification for the 0.95 threshold. Without a deterministic method the requirement cannot be verified automatically.

"SC-003: ... AND an external semantic equivalence check (e.g., expert human rating or visual similarity score ≥ 0.95)" repeats the ambiguity of FR-005 and does not specify how the external check will be performed or how its result will be recorded, making the success criterion untestable.

The acceptance scenario for counterbalancing uses placeholders "[deferred]" and does not describe a measurable verification procedure (e.g., ensuring each participant experiences each interface first in 50 % of sessions). The lack of a concrete check makes the requirement unverifiable.
